capabilities.name: Startup snapshot of bootstrap.js
capabilities.note: JSC exposes no startup-snapshot API: bootstrap.js is evaluated at start-up, the bytecode cache is the mitigation.

capabilities.name: Several global contexts in one VM (frame realms)
capabilities.note: A JSContextGroup holds several global contexts: compatible with frame realms.

capabilities.name: Compiled-code cache
capabilities.note: Bun already ships a bytecode cache over CachedBytecode.

capabilities.name: Near-heap-limit callback and heap statistics
capabilities.note: No JSC header declares a heap limit hook; Bun's V8 shim stores the callback but never fires it. Needs a memory-cost poll or a WebKit patch.

adjacent.why: At the WebKit pin 5718a6ec, Heap.cpp uses Options::gcMaxHeapSize as a GC-request threshold on bytes allocated in the cycle: it bounds garbage, not live memory, and has no callback or termination.

capabilities.name: Terminate a running script (watchdog)
capabilities.note: VM::notifyNeedTermination is the JSC counterpart of IsolateHandle::terminate_execution.

capabilities.name: Engine flags
capabilities.note: V8 flag strings do not map one to one: translate or drop.

capabilities.name: Process default ICU locale
capabilities.note: WTF::overrideUserPreferredLanguages is declared and exported by WTF but no Bun source calls it: the embedder (realm host) must call it. bun:jsc.setTimeZone sets the time zone, not the locale.

adjacent.why: bun:jsc.setTimeZone calls WTF::setTimeZoneOverride: a time-zone override, not the default locale.

capabilities.name: ES module loader and evaluation
capabilities.note: Bun owns its module loader hooks (resolve, fetch, evaluate).

capabilities.name: Host functions (ops) callable from JS
capabilities.note: The 74 synchronous ops map to host functions; there is no async op to port.

capabilities.name: Microtask queue draining
capabilities.note: The event loop becomes Bun's instead of deno_core plus tokio.

capabilities.name: Timer queue driven by the host event loop (Deno.core.createTimer and cancelTimer)
capabilities.note: Not a V8 API: bootstrap.js calls deno_core's timer queue (a refed timer keeps the event loop alive). JSC has no timer API; Bun's EventLoopTimer is the embedder-side counterpart the realm host must expose.

capabilities.name: Unhandled and handled promise-rejection hooks and the uncaught-exception reporter
capabilities.note: bootstrap.js installs three deno_core callbacks. JSGlobalObjectMethodTable has promiseRejectionTracker and reportUncaughtExceptionAtEventLoop, which Bun already implements.

mitigations.name: Poll the heap from the host, then terminate
mitigations.note: bun:jsc exports heapStats, memoryUsage and percentAvailableMemoryInUse; the host would poll and call the termination path. Existence only: probe P1 of docs/plans/fusion/bench/METHOD.md must exercise it.

mitigations.name: Frame realms through ShadowRealm or node:vm contexts
mitigations.note: Alternatives to JSContextGroup/JSGlobalContextCreateInGroup for one realm per frame.

mitigations.name: Bytecode cache reachable from JS (node:vm cachedData)
mitigations.note: Enables the one-hour node:vm trial of decision 14 before any Rust port.

mitigations.name: JSC options settable by environment
mitigations.note: BUN_JSC_<option> sets a JSC option; useJIT=0 gives the interpreter-only lane required by METHOD C5.

bunV8Shim.note: Isolate::AddNearHeapLimitCallback is stored but never fired (JSC has no near-heap-limit hook)
